# Retained predecessor dependency

Source: `ProveIt_Modular_Morse_Certificates_2026-10-12.zip`, an existing
ProveIt research continuation retrieved from the user Library.

`ranked_morse.py` is byte-identical to `code/ranked_morse.py`.
`morse_verify.py` is byte-identical to `code/verify.py`; only the destination
filename was changed to avoid confusing it with the new independent flag
checker. `LICENSE` is byte-identical to the archive license. Exact original
and delivered hashes are in `provenance/sources.json`.

The adapter invokes this existing arithmetic implementation; it is not a
mock of its API. New cone and source-adapter tests were run. The predecessor's
entire independent test suite was not rerun here. Its original results remain
results of that earlier package, not new validation counts in this report.

No external scholarly PDFs or repository binaries are redistributed.
